title: Match Engram idempotency and unknown-grant semantics in doubles
outcome: The fake and PowerShell/bash fixtures lack bind/checkpoint idempotency receipt tables, key begin intent only by grant_id instead of delivery tokens, do not persist turn_already_open refusals, and fabricate grant_scope_mismatch for unknown grants where the binary reports turn_grant_not_found. This can make recovery tests enshrine behavior that differs from the real Engram binary.
acceptance: All Engram doubles independently mirror bind/checkpoint idempotency replay, token-scoped begin intent, persisted refusal replay, and real unknown-grant error shapes; a timed-out-applied checkpoint retry behaves like the real binary in focused tests.
